RecordBatcher::with_window (ADR 0047), only when a window is set. An
event with no time is outside any window. Dropped events are counted.

Pipeline::run_marking: the parser’s steps, then [[pipeline]] in profile
order. A step runs on the records its when selects and keeps the rest
unchanged.

The store writer assigns ids, applies the source’s clock offset, writes
Parquet segments, adds the SourceInfo to the catalog and indexes the
words.

div.div: Transform: drop, keep, mask, remove_fields, rename, set, set_level, truncate, parse_json, parse_kv, lookup, shift_time, calc, or a plugin step by installed id. Dedupe: collapses repeats of timed records in a window and adds RepeatCount. Script: Rhai, sandboxed, at most 100,000 operations.

text.tspan: Step kinds
Transform: drop, keep, mask, remove_fields, rename, set, set_level, truncate, parse_json,
parse_kv, lookup, shift_time, calc, or a plugin step by installed id. Dedupe: collapses repeats of
timed records in a window and adds RepeatCount. Script: Rhai, sandboxed, at most 100,000
operations.

div.div: A calc or script that does not compile is a profile error, so it never reaches ingest. At run time a calc that cannot evaluate leaves the record unchanged; a script error keeps the record and counts it in StepStats. Disabled steps stay as placeholders so step indexes line up.

text.tspan: Failure rules
A calc or script that does not compile is a profile error, so it never reaches ingest. At run time a calc
that cannot evaluate leaves the record unchanged; a script error keeps the record and counts it in
StepStats. Disabled steps stay as placeholders so step indexes line up.
